claim_boundary: C022 registers twenty-four attacks. None is decisive or terminal. The three descendants remain formalizing pending external mathematical review.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: residual simplification may be treated as a proof inference
attacks.method: Retain a root-derived witness for every residual and verify that each recorded local resolvent is exactly the restriction of one legal root resolvent.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: implied literals or sibling clauses may require semantic weakening
attacks.method: Eliminate units in reverse reason order and use the decision-subclause branch trichotomy; fuzz opposite units, multiple batches, post-Resolution conflict and a depth-two tree.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the theorem may apply only to an instrumented clone
attacks.method: Differentially compare production Policy0T and TracePolicy on 500 non-affine UNSAT formulas across answer and seven work/structure counters.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: translator and verifier may share the same bug
attacks.method: Serialize emitted proofs and replay them with a separately implemented checker; reject corrupted pivot, final clause, axiom and parent index certificates.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: larger parity-of-MAJ3 blocks may become affine
attacks.method: Fix every block except one; the remaining slice is a nonempty non-affine MAJ3 fibre, contradicting affinity of the full relation.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the implementation may nevertheless recognize local lifted blocks as affine
attacks.method: Exhaust both charges for degrees one through four and call the exact affine-equation routine on every reconstructed relation.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: logical equivalence may hide a costly translation between the JANUS CNF and theorem lift
attacks.method: Construct the clause-wise standard CNF lift and the direct exact local relation CNF independently; compare canonical clause sets for both charges and degrees one through four.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: two vertex relations may merge under identical exact scopes
attacks.method: Restrict the target to simple constant-degree expander graphs; distinct vertices cannot share the same complete incident-edge scope without parallel-only adjacency, so local groups remain separate.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the size-depth tradeoff may be algebraically rearranged in the wrong direction
attacks.method: Substitute w>=cn and D<=An into D>=k w^2/log S, derive log S>=(kc^2/A)n, then use S<=aW to obtain W>=2^{Omega(n)}.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the lifted encoding may have superlinear size in the base parameter
attacks.method: Use constant base degree and constant MAJ3 arity; every vertex contributes a constant number of constant-width clauses, so variables, clauses and encoding length are Theta(n).

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the lifting theorem may require a different gadget, proof system, encoding or size convention
attacks.method: Check the registered 2026 primary source: it applies to any unsatisfiable CNF of Resolution width w and any 1-stifling gadget including MAJ3, with Res(⊕) depth Omega(w^2/log S).

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the selected expander-Tseitin family may lack linear Resolution width in the chosen parameter
attacks.method: Map Urquhart's expander-Tseitin exponential lower bound and the Ben-Sasson-Wigderson expansion-to-width framework; exact family and constants remain an external review gate.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: H132 states only asymptotic O(W),O(N) overhead
attacks.method: H135 supplies the explicit bounds S<=m+r+u+b+o and D<=2N+2 for the same non-affine core.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: H134 may remain only a depth-one finite witness
attacks.method: Generalize the decision-subclause invariant to every terminal and branch case; verify 500 random translations and an independent checker while retaining external proof review.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the mixed full-dispatcher Res(⊕) target may be needed for the current lower bound
attacks.method: H136 proves the MAJ3 target always enters affine_answer=None, so H137 needs only H135 and does not depend on completion of the full-dispatcher affine certificate.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the universal Tear policy target may retain Policy-0T as a plausible polynomial candidate
attacks.method: H137 conditionally yields an exponential infinite-family lower bound for the exact Policy-0T non-affine core, forcing any H129 candidate to add another proof-theoretic resource.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: formula caching may be considered an implementation detail after the no-cache proof
attacks.method: The H137 route attacks only the no-cache core; H131 remains a distinct proof-system problem because cache reuse is not represented by the tree induction.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the high-treewidth lift route may still lack a rigorous consequence
attacks.method: H137 supplies a proof-complexity lower bound for one exact policy on a lifted Tseitin family, while preserving H119's broader factorization theorem as open.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the original visible Tseitin family is easy for the affine dispatcher
attacks.method: H136 replaces visible local parity by exact MAJ3-lifted blocks that remain theorem-identical but are non-affine to the current detector.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: global parity may still bypass the non-affine lower-bound target
attacks.method: The MAJ3 lift hides every local affine block from the registered dispatcher while preserving the exact lifted proof-complexity instance.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: a Policy-0T lower bound may be mistaken for the universal compiler factorization theorem
attacks.method: Record that H137 excludes one solver core and neither proves nor refutes H127's all-transduction quotient claim.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the exact Policy-0T core may represent every H106 compiler
attacks.method: Policy-0T is a particular DPLL/Resolution search procedure, not the entire bounded-pass low-treewidth transduction class.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: H135 may contradict the fixed-gadget Circuit-Frege upper bound
attacks.method: H135 translates SAT-search traces to Resolution and does not construct equivalent-circuit rewrite endpoints; H117 remains orthogonal.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: C022 may silently revive H130's false full-dispatcher ordinary-Resolution claim
attacks.method: H135 explicitly assumes affine_answer=None and H136 proves that assumption only for the selected MAJ3 target; the full dispatcher remains outside ordinary Resolution simulation.
